replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Eternal Forest, has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you remove some void and increase the size of the map. There is too much void and the map is very small overall. Expand the islands and remove some void.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You may resubmit your map once edited.
